entry.title: New: Resolution 204 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR FOUR GRAPPLE TRUCKS TO BE USED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with an approximate total monthly cost of $20,823.62, to be used to perform routine maintenance functions.
